method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module (built-in date functions, no daydate), the rules in one module and the person aggrieved's questions in a seat module importing it; three regulative rules (the s 65 complaint time limit, the s 72 lapse notice and the s 81 request for referral) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Anti-Discrimination Act 1992 (NT), reprint REPA027 as in force at 27 July 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/Anti-Discrimination-Act-1992-NT-current-reprint-REPA027.txt (file sha256 bb94528fd82051c8cc419d73e8e4e6da0b1e6caaa4e57b876c63ab003bcca2fe; the .meta.json records text sha256 950c52f3...0dd1 for the converted text), retrieved from legislation.nt.gov.au on 2026-11-06

seat: the person aggrieved: the individual treated badly who may complain to the Anti-Discrimination Commissioner (a worker or job applicant, student, tenant, customer, club member, person seeking insurance or superannuation, person dealing with a Territory agency) (nad-seat.l4); exemptions the respondent must prove (s 91(2)) are asked from the same seat

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run nad-dates.l4 ; l4 run nad-rules.l4 ; l4 run nad-seat.l4 ; l4 run nad-cases.l4
checks.result: 211 assertions written, 211 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read and counted by distinct source range. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets. In: ss 4 (attribute, child, club and the attribute definitions as glosses), 19, 20, 20A, 20B, 21, 22, 23, 24, 26, 27, 28 and Part 4's areas (ss 29, 31-34, 38, 41, 46, 48, 49A as the choice of area), the exemptions ss 30, 35, 35A, 35B, 36, 37, 39, 40, 42-45, 47, 49, 50-58 and 59 (as a fact), and Part 6 as it meets the complainant: ss 60, 64 (in a description), 65, 66, 66D, 66F, 71(4), 72, 79, 80, 81, 86, 87(1), 88, 89 (in a description), 91 (in descriptions), 105; s 106(2); ss 116, 122, 123, 126, 127, 128. Out: Parts 2 and 2A, s 25 and the offences of Part 8, s 31(3), the Commissioner's and Tribunal's procedure, Division 4B, s 68(2) stays, s 117 and the regulations (not deposited). Reasons in NOTES.md.
